user.title: DJI Flight Log
user.description: Folder that receives the DJI Fly flight records (*.txt). Newer logs (v13+) are encrypted; a free DJI Developer API key is needed to decode the GPS track and telemetry. Without it only the header data (time, duration, distance, max height) is imported.
